description: Binary quadratic forms (sage.quadratic_forms.binary_qf): Gauss composition, reduction, class groups, cycles, equivalence and solve_integer, compared against SageMath

cases.description: discriminant/content/is_* on 37 structured forms: zero form, singular D=0, square and non-square discriminants, negative definite, imprimitive (content 2,3,6), a=0 and c=0 degenerate shapes
the same accessors on coefficients astride 2^53 and beyond (2^64+1, 10^20) - the port stores coefficients as bigint, SageMath as GMP Integers

is_reduced on 51 forms sitting exactly on the reduction boundaries: -a<b<=a<c, 0<=b<=a==c, the negative definite mirror, and all three indefinite branches (b>0 & ac<0, a=0, c=0), plus large coefficients well clear of SageMath 10.3's float-sqrt blind spot
Q(x,y) at 42 points including (0,0), negative coordinates and 2^54-sized products
matrix_action_right/left for 40 (form, matrix) pairs including the zero matrix, a rank-deficient matrix, det=-1 and a non-unimodular scaling
BinaryQF.principal(D) for every D in [-40, 40]: valid for D = 0,1 mod 4 and ValueError otherwise
BinaryQF.principal at 2^53 boundaries and beyond
reduced_form under algorithm='default'/'pari'/'sage' for 23 definite forms (positive and negative definite, imprimitive, already-reduced and far-from-reduced)
reduced_form under all three algorithms for 24 square-discriminant (reducible) forms - PARI has no t_QFB there, so this is Sage's own _reduce_indef

reduced_form(transformation=True) under all three algorithms for 20 indefinite non-square forms - qfbredsl2, whose normalisation is stable across PARI versions - checking that matrix_action_right(M) reproduces the reduced form and det(M) = 1
the same for 23 definite forms
the same for 24 square-discriminant forms (Sage's _reduce_indef with transformation)

reduced_form(transformation=True) for indefinite forms with coefficients astride 2^53 and up to 2^80 (PARI qfbredsl2 only; Sage's _reduce_indef loop does not terminate on these in SageMath 10.3 - issue #37635)
the same for definite forms with coefficients astride 2^53 and 2^64
class invariant (sorted proper cycle of reduced_form) for 20 indefinite non-square forms - version independent where the raw qfbred representative is not
class invariant for indefinite forms of moderate discriminant, including imprimitive ones

cycle() and cycle(proper=True) for 22 forms: reduced indefinite ones (the supported case), non-reduced indefinite ones, definite ones and square-discriminant ones (both ValueError / NotImplementedError paths)

full raw Gauss composition (PARI qfbcompraw) over 8 discriminants x every ordered pair of forms - 648 compositions, half of them with gcd(a,b) > 1 or imprimitive content, which is exactly where the port's hand-written composition used to be wrong
composition with coefficients astride 2^53 / 2^61 / 2^80

solve_integer on the ZERO form (a=b=c=0). KNOWN PORT DEFECT: binary_qf.ts throws ZeroDivisionError('rational division by zero') for every n, while binary_qf.py:1776 guards with Q._a.divides(n) and so returns None for n != 0, and raises 'Integer division by zero' only for n = 0
